cards.heading: Your brain on THC
cards.body: Cannabis triggers dopamine release in the brain's reward centre. Over time your brain adjusts by reducing its natural dopamine production — which is why quitting can feel flat or anxious at first.

cards.heading: The craving window
cards.body: Most cravings peak at around 20 minutes then fade, even without using. Your job is simply to outlast the wave.

cards.heading: It's not weakness
cards.body: Cravings are a normal brain response to habit disruption. Feeling one doesn't mean you're failing — it means your brain is adjusting.

cards.prompt: Think of the last time you had a craving. What were you doing, and how long did it actually last?
